question: On which of the following occasions the lunar eclipse occurs? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: New moon
Full moon
Third quadrature
First quadrature
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Full moon

Explanation:
A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, casting its shadow on the Moon. This alignment happens only during a full moon, when the Moon is on the opposite side of the Earth from the Sun. During a new moon, the Sun and Moon are in the same direction, causing a solar eclipse. In quadrature positions, the Moon is not in a straight line with the Earth and Sun, so no eclipse occurs. The Earth's shadow has two parts: the penumbra (partial shadow) and the umbra (full shadow). In a total lunar eclipse, the Moon moves completely into the umbra, while in a partial eclipse, it only partially enters the umbra. Lunar eclipses are safe to view without eye protection, unlike solar eclipses.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ On which day does a lunar eclipse occur? → Full moon
☛ On which day does a solar eclipse occur? → New moon
☛ Where is Earth positioned during a lunar eclipse? → Between the Sun and the Moon
☛ What are the two parts of Earth's shadow? → Penumbra and Umbra
☛ Which shadow does the Moon enter during a total lunar eclipse? → Umbra
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस अवसर पर चंद्र ग्रहण होता है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)

पूर्ण चंद्र
तीसरा चतुर्भुज
पहला चतुर्भुज
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है पूर्ण चंद्र

Explanation:
चंद्र ग्रहण तब होता है जब पृथ्वी सूर्य और चंद्रमा के बीच आ जाती है, जिससे पृथ्वी की छाया चंद्रमा पर पड़ती है। यह स्थिति केवल पूर्णिमा के दिन ही संभव है, जब चंद्रमा पृथ्वी के विपरीत दिशा में सूर्य के सापेक्ष होता है। अमावस्या पर सूर्य और चंद्रमा एक ही दिशा में होते हैं, जिससे सूर्य ग्रहण होता है। चतुर्भुज की स्थितियों में चंद्रमा पृथ्वी और सूर्य के बीच सीधी रेखा में नहीं होता, इसलिए ग्रहण नहीं बनता। पृथ्वी की छाया दो प्रकार की होती है: उपच्छाया और प्रच्छाया। पूर्ण चंद्र ग्रहण में चंद्रमा पूरी तरह प्रच्छाया में आ जाता है, जबकि आंशिक ग्रहण में वह आंशिक रूप से प्रच्छाया में होता है।

question: Which is the outermost part of the earth? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Core
Crust
Asthenosphere
Mantle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Crust

Explanation:
The outermost layer of the Earth's internal structure is the Crust. It is a solid rocky layer that forms the Earth's surface. The thickness of the crust is about 30-50 km on continents and about 5-10 km on the ocean floor. Beneath it lies the Mantle, followed by the Outer Core and the Inner Core. The boundary between the crust and mantle is called the Mohorovicic Discontinuity (Moho). The crust is of two types: Continental crust (granite) and Oceanic crust (basalt). Being the outermost part, the crust is the thinnest layer of the Earth.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Thinnest layer of the Earth → Crust
☛ Thickest layer of the Earth → Mantle
☛ Boundary between crust and mantle → Mohorovicic Discontinuity (Moho)
☛ Main rock type of continental crust → Granite
☛ Main rock type of oceanic crust → Basalt
question_hi: पृथ्वी का सबसे बाहरी भाग कौन सा है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)

पर्पटी
दुर्बलतामंडल (Asthenosphere)
मैंटल
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है पर्पटी

Explanation:
पृथ्वी की आंतरिक संरचना में सबसे बाहरी परत पर्पटी (Crust) है। यह एक ठोस चट्टानी परत है जो पृथ्वी की सतह बनाती है। पर्पटी की मोटाई महाद्वीपों पर लगभग 30-50 किमी और समुद्र तल पर लगभग 5-10 किमी होती है। इसके नीचे मैंटल, फिर बाहरी क्रोड और सबसे अंदर आंतरिक क्रोड आता है। पर्पटी और मैंटल के बीच की सीमा को मोहोरोविच सतह (Moho) कहा जाता है। पर्पटी दो प्रकार की होती है: महाद्वीपीय पर्पटी (ग्रेनाइट) और समुद्री पर्पटी (बेसाल्ट)। पृथ्वी का सबसे बाहरी भाग होने के कारण पर्पटी सबसे पतली परत है।

question: The east coast of India is a: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: coast with fjords
low sedimentary coast
concordant coastline
rocky retreating coast
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is low sedimentary coast

Explanation:
The eastern coast of India, also known as the Coromandel Coast, is a low sedimentary coast. It lies along the Bay of Bengal and is characterized by wide, flat land and sand dunes. This coast has been formed by sediments brought down by rivers, creating alluvial plains. The eastern coast features numerous deltas, such as those of the Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri rivers. The slope of the eastern coast is gentle, resulting in less tidal impact compared to the western coast. In contrast, the western coast is a high coast. Thus, the eastern coast of India is an example of a low sedimentary coast.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Alternate name for the east coast of India → Coromandel Coast
☛ Major rivers associated with the east coast → Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri, Mahanadi
☛ Major ports on the east coast → Chennai, Visakhapatnam, Paradip
☛ Difference between east and west coast → East coast is low sedimentary, west coast is high and rocky
☛ Extent of the east coast → From Sundarbans to Kanyakumari
question_hi: भारत का पूर्वी तट है: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: फ़ियोर्ड तट
निम्न तलछटी तट
समवर्ती तटरेखा
चट्टानी निवर्तनी तट
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है निम्न तलछटी तट

Explanation:
भारत का पूर्वी तट, जिसे कोरोमंडल तट भी कहा जाता है, एक निम्न तलछटी तट है। यह तट बंगाल की खाड़ी के साथ स्थित है और इसकी विशेषता चौड़ी, समतल भूमि और रेत के टीलों की उपस्थिति है। यह तट नदियों द्वारा लाए गए अवसादों से निर्मित हुआ है, जिससे यह जलोढ़ मैदान बनाता है। इस तट पर कई डेल्टा पाए जाते हैं, जैसे गोदावरी, कृष्णा और कावेरी नदियों के डेल्टा। पूर्वी तट की ढाल हल्की होती है, जिसके कारण यहाँ ज्वार-भाटा का प्रभाव कम होता है। इसके विपरीत, पश्चिमी तट एक उच्च तट है। इस प्रकार, भारत का पूर्वी तट निम्न तलछटी तट का उदाहरण है।

question: Where are one-horned rhinoceros is found in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Meghalaya
Assam
Bihar
Madhya Pradesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Assam

Explanation:
In India, the one-horned rhinoceros (Indian rhinoceros) is primarily found in the state of Assam. Its main habitat is Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This rhino, scientifically known as Rhinoceros unicornis, has a single horn and thick skin with natural armor-like folds. Its diet mainly consists of grass and aquatic plants. The majority of India's rhino population resides in Assam's protected areas including Kaziranga, Manas, Pobitora, and Orang National Parks. It is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Scientific name of Indian one-horned rhinoceros → Rhinoceros unicornis
☛ Kaziranga National Park is located in which state → Assam
☛ IUCN status of one-horned rhinoceros → Vulnerable
☛ Famous rhino sanctuary in India → Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary, Assam
☛ Schedule under which rhino is protected → Schedule I of Wildlife Protection Act

असम
बिहार
मध्य प्रदेश
solution_hi:

Explanation:
भारत में एक सींग वाला गैंडा (भारतीय गैंडा) मुख्य रूप से असम राज्य में पाया जाता है। इसका प्रमुख आवास काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान है, जो यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल है। यह गैंडा विशाल एक सींग वाला गैंडा (Rhinoceros unicornis) कहलाता है और इसकी त्वचा पर प्राकृतिक सुरक्षा कवच के रूप में मोटी परतें होती हैं। इसका प्रमुख आहार घास और जलीय पौधे हैं। भारत में इसकी आबादी का बड़ा हिस्सा असम के काजीरंगा, मानस, पोबितोरा और ओरांग राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों में पाया जाता है। यह संकटग्रस्त प्रजाति है और वन्यजीव संरक्षण अधिनियम 1972 की अनुसूची-I में शामिल है।

question: How does most of India's foreign trade take place? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Through land and sea routes
Through land and air routes
Equally through land, air and sea routes each
Through sea and air routes
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Through sea and air routes

Explanation:
Most of India's foreign trade takes place through sea and air routes. Sea routes are the most economical for transporting heavy and bulk cargo, while air routes are used for quick transport of valuable and perishable goods. Land routes are limited to neighboring countries and account for a very small share. Major Indian ports like Mumbai, Nhava Sheva, Chennai, and Kolkata handle sea trade, while international airports such as Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru lead air trade. Overall, sea and air routes play the most significant role in India's foreign trade.

☛ Which route is best for exporting perishable goods? → Air route
☛ Which is India's busiest port? → Nhava Sheva (Jawaharlal Nehru Port)
☛ Which is India's largest international airport? → Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi

Explanation:

question: In which state is the Mudumalai National Park located? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Andhra Pradesh
Gujarat
Tamil Nadu
Maharashtra
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tamil Nadu

Explanation:
Mudumalai National Park is located in the state of Tamil Nadu. It is situated in the Nilgiri Hills and is a part of the Tiger Reserve. The park covers an area of approximately 321 sq km. It was established in 1978. The park is home to animals like elephants, tigers, leopards, sambar, and spotted deer. It shares its boundaries with Bandipur National Park (Karnataka) and Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary (Kerala). The name 'Mudumalai' means ancient hill in the Tamil language. It is a part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site.

☛ Mudumalai is a part of which sanctuary → Tiger Reserve
question_hi: मुदुमलाई राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/02/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश
गुजरात
तमिलनाडु
महाराष्ट्र

Solution: सही उत्तर है तमिलनाडु

Explanation:
मुदुमलाई राष्ट्रीय उद्यान तमिलनाडु राज्य में स्थित है। यह उद्यान नीलगिरि पहाड़ियों पर स्थित है और यह बाघ अभयारण्य का हिस्सा है। मुदुमलाई का क्षेत्रफल लगभग 321 वर्ग किमी है। यह उद्यान 1978 में स्थापित किया गया था। यहां हाथी, बाघ, तेंदुआ, सांभर, और चीतल जैसे जानवर पाए जाते हैं। यह उद्यान बांदीपुर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (कर्नाटक) और वायनाड वन्यजीव अभयारण्य (केरल) के साथ सीमा साझा करता है। मुदुमलाई का अर्थ तमिल भाषा में प्राचीन पहाड़ी होता है। यह यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल का हिस्सा है।

question: During a cyclonic storm, abnormal rise in sea level is known as ___________.  (RPF Constable 2018 (02/02/2019))

Saash

question: Rainfall occurs in the coastal areas of Tamil Nadu for the beginning of winter due to _____ reason.  (RPF Constable 2018 (02/02/2019))
options: Tropical Cyclone
North Eastern Monsoon
Southwest Monsoon
Western Storm
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is North Eastern Monsoon

Explanation:
Rainfall in the coastal areas of Tamil Nadu at the beginning of winter is due to the North Eastern Monsoon. This monsoon is active from October to December and brings moisture from the Bay of Bengal, causing rainfall along the Tamil Nadu coast. The Southwest Monsoon causes less rainfall in Tamil Nadu as it originates from the Arabian Sea and is blocked by the Western Ghats. The North Eastern Monsoon is also called the 'Retreating Monsoon'. It is the main source of rainfall for Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and parts of Kerala. Although tropical cyclones and western storms can also cause rainfall, the primary reason for regular winter rainfall is the North Eastern Monsoon.

question: Which of the following is found in the sea cow or dugong?  (RPF Constable 2018 (02/02/2019))

Coromandel Coast
Gulf of Khambhat

question: Tropical cyclones are known in the _____ as 'Taifu'. (RPF Constable 2018 (02/02/2019))
options: Philippines
Japan
South Korea
China
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Japan

Explanation:
Tropical cyclones are known by different names in various parts of the world. In the western Pacific Ocean, particularly around Japan and China, they are called 'Taifu'. This term is derived from the Chinese language meaning 'strong wind'. Meanwhile, in the Atlantic and eastern Pacific Oceans, they are called hurricanes, and in the Indian Ocean and South Pacific, they are called cyclones. This naming is based on regional conventions set by the World Meteorological Organization. Thus, the term 'Taifu' is specifically used for cyclones in the Northwest Pacific region, with Japan being a key area affected by these storms.

question: The cloud of dust and gas inside the galaxy is called - (RPF Constable 2018 (02/02/2019))
options: Neutron Stars
Black Dwarf
Nebula
Black Hole
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nebula

Explanation:
The cloud of dust and gas inside the galaxy is called a Nebula. A nebula is a vast interstellar cloud composed of hydrogen, helium, and other gases along with dust particles. These are the birthplaces of stars, where gravity causes the gas and dust to condense and form new stars. Major types of nebulae include Emission Nebula, Reflection Nebula, and Dark Nebula. Neutron stars and Black holes are end stages of stars, while Black Dwarf is a hypothetical stellar remnant. Hence, the correct option is Nebula.

question: Himalaya Frontal Fault separates Shivalik from ________. (RPF Constable 2018 (03/02/2019))
options: Small Himalaya
Central Himalayas
The Great Himalayas
Great Plains of India
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Great Plains of India

Explanation:
The Himalayan Frontal Fault (HFF) is a major geological structure located at the southernmost boundary of the Himalayas. It separates the Shivalik Hills from the Great Plains of India (Indo-Gangetic Plains). This fault was formed due to the collision of the Indian Plate with the Eurasian Plate during the formation of the Himalayas. The Himalayas are divided into three main parts: the Great Himalayas or Himadri (northern part), the Middle Himalayas or Himachal, and the Shivaliks (southern part). The Himalayan Frontal Fault separates the Shivaliks from the plains, while the Main Boundary Thrust (MBT) separates the Shivaliks from the Middle Himalayas, and the Main Central Thrust (MCT) separates the Middle Himalayas from the Great Himalayas.
